hints.title: Prefix Parity Differential
hints.text: A subarray sum from i to j is odd if and only if the parity of prefix sum at j differs from the parity of prefix sum at i - 1.

hints.title: Running Parity Frequency
hints.text: Maintain counts of even and odd prefix sums seen so far. Initialize even count to 1 for the empty prefix sum 0.

hints.title: Accumulate Modulo
hints.text: For each element, update running sum. If current prefix is odd, add even count to answer; if even, add odd count. Take modulo 10^9 + 7.

hints.title: See the blueprint
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def numOfSubarrays(self, arr: list[int]) -> int:
        MOD = 10**9 + 7
        even = 1
        odd = 0
        cur = 0
        ans = 0
        for x in arr:
            cur += x
            if cur % 2 == 1:
                ans = (ans + even) % MOD
                odd += 1
            else:
                ans = (ans + odd) % MOD
                even += 1
        return ans
```

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Iterating over all O(N^2) subarrays times out for N = 10^5.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Tracking two parity counters in a single pass achieves optimal O(N) time and O(1) memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate reduces subarray sum parity to prefix parity transitions.
